commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Juventus take a short corner kick.

90+4' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to place a shot inside the left post, but Stefano Turati makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory.
90+1' We are about to witness a subsitution. Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) for Weston McKennie.

3' Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza) was too forceful with his tackle and Davide Massa interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
